metadata.title: Restructure Tests to Mirror Code Organization

story.iWant: to reorganize tests to mirror the dagster_project structure
story.soThat: tests are easy to discover and maintain alongside their corresponding code
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Create mirrored test directory structure (AC: 1) - Create tests/assets/ directory - Create tests/ops/ directory - Create tests/resources/ directory - Create tests/jobs/ directory - Verify tests/integration/ already exists
- Task 2: Move test files to appropriate directories (AC: 2) - Move test_link_ingestion.py → tests/assets/ - Move test_html_extractor.py → tests/ops/ - Move test_youtube_extractor.py → tests/ops/ - Move test_openai.py → tests/resources/ - Move test_jobs.py → tests/jobs/ - Verify test_pipeline_integration.py already in tests/integration/
- Task 3: Update test imports and references (AC: 3) - Update imports in moved test files to reference bronze/silver asset names - Update asset references: link_ingestion → bronze_raw_links - Update asset references: content_extraction → silver_extracted_content - Update asset references: summaries → silver_summaries - Update IOManager references where applicable
- Task 4: Verify test markers are preserved (AC: 6) - Check all tests retain @pytest.mark.unit or @pytest.mark.integration decorators - Verify @pytest.mark.contract markers for API tests - Add any missing markers based on test type
- Task 5: Run pytest discovery and execution (AC: 4, 5) - Run uv run pytest --collect-only to verify discovery - Run uv run pytest to execute all tests - Verify all tests pass in new structure - Debug and fix any import or reference errors
- Task 6: Run quality checks (AC: 4) - Run make check - verify format, lint, typecheck pass - Verify no regressions introduced

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Test directories created: tests/assets/, tests/ops/, tests/resources/, tests/jobs/ - Directory structure verified AC2: Existing tests moved to appropriate directories - Files in correct locations AC3: Tests updated to reference new asset and IOManager names - Import statements and references verified AC4: All tests pass with new structure - pytest run succeeds AC5: pytest discovery works correctly with new structure - All tests discovered and executable AC6: Test markers (unit, integration) preserved - Markers verified in test files

constraints.constraint: Test directories MUST mirror dagster_project structure: assets/, ops/, resources/, jobs/
NO __init__.py files in test directories unless beneficial (per CLAUDE.md)
Tests use absolute imports from dagster_project (not relative imports)
pytest discovery requires test_*.py naming pattern
Must run make check after restructuring to verify format, lint, typecheck pass
Integration tests only (per CLAUDE.md) - folder structure mirrors code for discoverability

tests.standards: Project uses pytest framework with strict marker enforcement. Tests are integration-focused (per CLAUDE.md) with structure mirroring code organization. Test files use test_*.py naming pattern. Markers include @pytest.mark.unit for fast isolated tests, @pytest.mark.integration for multi-component tests, and @pytest.mark.contract for external API verification. Configuration in pyproject.toml sets testpaths=["tests"], strict markers, and verbose output. No __init__.py files in test directories unless beneficial. Tests use absolute imports from dagster_project. Quality checks via make check (format, lint, typecheck) must pass after changes.

Verify new asset references: grep for bronze_raw_links, silver_extracted_content, silver_summaries in moved test files
Run pytest --collect-only to verify discovery finds all tests in new structure
Run uv run pytest to execute all tests and verify they pass
